comments: Simple and practical approach, but applicability limited to elastic materials with small deformations; nonlinear regime unexplored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dimensionless tube deformation depends only on transmural load ratio for sufficiently long/slender tubes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; experimental validation with two materials

title: Pressure-dependent structural, mechanical, and electronic properties of XAu (X = Er, Tm) intermetallic compounds from first-principles calculations
task: Characterize pressure-dependent elastic and electronic properties of rare-earth intermetallics
key_results: ErAu Young's modulus 96.61 GPa, TmAu 73.94 GPa at zero pressure; Debye temperatures 193 K (ErAu) and 167 K (TmAu); mechanical stability maintained to ~20 GPa; both compounds show ductility and elastic anisotropy; GGA+U confirms metallic character with pressure-insensitive 4f localization
comments: Comprehensive DFT study provides useful reference data but lacks experimental validation; 4f treatment via Hubbard U somewhat phenomenological.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hydrostatic pressure enhances stiffness and preserves mechanical stability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; elastic constants and Debye temperature increase with pressure

title: Interplay of bound states in the continuum and Fano–Andreev interference in a hybrid triple quantum dot
task: Study bound states in continuum (BICs) and Fano-Andreev interference in hybrid quantum dots
key_results: Andreev-type BIC forms in symmetric limit, transitions to quasi-BIC with detuning; electron transmission shows antiresonances evolving into near-zero minima; bias-dependent occupational redistribution correlates with BIC signatures
comments: Interplay of superconductivity and quantum interference produces rich quasi-BIC physics, with internal diagnostics accessible via transport measurements.

model_io.model: Triple quantum dot with superconducting coupling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fano-Andreev interference produces Andreev-type BICs in symmetric configuration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; crossover to quasi-BIC observed with lateral detuning

title: Elucidation of physical, structural, optical and luminescence properties of Cr2O3-doped B2O3-TeO2-Li2O-SrO glasses for deep red-light and NIR luminescence applications
task: Develop chromium-doped borate-tellurite glasses for deep-red and NIR emission
key_results: CdS-doped BTLSC glasses (2 wt%) show bandgap reduction from 3.44 to 2.58 eV; photoluminescence peaks at ~690 nm and ~750 nm; CIE coordinates and CCT values suitable for deep red-light solid-state lighting
comments: Comprehensive characterization but lacks comparison with competing red-emitting materials or detailed quantum yield/lifetime measurements.

title: A rigorous analytical model and design framework for broadband graphene based THz absorbers
task: Design broadband graphene-based THz absorbers analytically
key_results: Analytical model enables systematic design of graphene ribbon arrays; achieves >90% absorption across 0.65-1.44 THz (76% bandwidth); model predictions match numerical results; fabrication tolerances incorporated
comments: Analytical framework valuable for design but applicability limited to ribbon geometries; polarization dependence and substrate effects require fuller treatment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Analytical model accurately predicts graphene absorber performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; comparison with numerical simulations shows excellent agreement

title: Unified GPU-based simulation of porous flow, absorption, and diffusion in cloth–liquid coupling
task: Simulate cloth-liquid coupling with porous flow and diffusion on GPU
key_results: Bitonic-sort GPU hashing reduces sorting overhead; unified SPH pipeline maintains stable wetting and bounded mass variation (~1% error); framework efficiently scales to high particle counts
comments: Efficient GPU implementation but validation limited to qualitative wet-cloth scenarios; quantitative comparison with ground truth absorption rates and diffusion kinetics absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Virtual-pressure formulation maintains directional robustness in porous flow
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stable wetting achieved near boundaries

title: Influence of Sb-doping on structural, optical and UV photodetector properties of CdS thin films
task: Optimize UV photodetector performance via Sb-doping in CdS thin films
key_results: 2 wt% Sb-doped CdS achieves responsivity 1.84 A/W, detectivity 4.60×10^9 Jones, EQE 626% at 365 nm; response time 1.02 s, recovery 0.56 s; hexagonal structure confirmed; stable cycling performance
comments: Strong UV photoresponse but responsivity definition and EQE >100% mechanism require clarification; comparison with commercial UV detectors lacking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sb-doping enhances light absorption and charge transport for improved UV response
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2 wt% doping optimizes crystallinity and grain density

title: Numerical study of viscous and rarefaction effects on choked flow in two-dimensional convergent conical nozzle
task: Model viscous and rarefaction effects on choked flow in microscale nozzles
key_results: Slip-flow predicts 3% higher mass flow rates than no-slip due to reduced shear; inviscid deviates ~1% from slip-flow at lowest pressure ratios; rarefaction effects significant below continuum regime; core-flow accelerations comparable across formulations at high pressure ratios
comments: Systematic comparison of boundary conditions useful for microscale design but limited to conical geometry; shock formation and higher Knudsen regimes unexplored.

model_io.model: Convergent conical nozzle flow (continuum to slip-flow regimes)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Slip-flow formulation captures viscous/rarefaction coupling for choked flow
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 3% mass flow deviation vs. no-slip shows boundary condition importance

title: Neural network approach to mitigating intra-gate crosstalk in superconducting CZ gates
task: Mitigate intra-gate crosstalk in superconducting qubits using neural control
key_results: Physics-guided neural framework achieves superior CZ gate fidelity vs. Krotov/GRAPE under matched constraints; consistent improvements in nominal and perturbed conditions; pronounced worst-case fidelity gains
comments: Combines hardware-aware parameterization with Hamiltonian-informed objectives, but scalability to larger qubit arrays and robustness across device variations require validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-guided neural control outperforms optimal control methods under crosstalk
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior fidelity and smoothness demonstrated numerically

title: The Quantum Optimization Benchmarking Library
task: Benchmark quantum optimization algorithms on standardized problem classes
key_results: Framework defines 10 model-independent problem classes (100 to ~100,000 variables); baseline results provided for quantum solvers; state-of-the-art classical solver track records referenced; open-source repository established
comments: Systematic benchmarking infrastructure useful for tracking progress, but quantum advantage demonstration still distant given classical solver performance.

title: Spatial analyses implicate high stromal tumour-infiltrating CD8+ lymphocytes as a negative predictive marker for chemotherapy in estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer
task: Identifying stromal immune biomarkers predictive of chemotherapy response in ER+HER2- breast cancer
key_results: Higher stromal CD8+ TIL density associated with poor chemotherapy outcome in intermediate Oncotype Dx RS cohort (ΔLR-χ²=6.79, p=0.009; validation ΔLR-χ²=8.90, p=0.003); stromal and epithelial immune states are decoupled
comments: Spatial proteomics/transcriptomics reveal cell-compartment-specific immune phenotypes, but mechanistic basis for why stromal CD8+ infiltration predicts chemo-resistance remains unclear.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed in intermediate RS cohort and validated on whole-resection specimens

title: Engineering drug-responsive replication machinery for precise control of self-amplifying RNA

key_results: Achieved >10⁴-fold on/off ratio with negligible background using trimethoprim-responsive degradation domains on non-structural proteins; oral trimethoprim enabled tunable, reversible, temporally programmed expression in mice; escalating dosing enhanced germinal centre responses to HIV antigen
